scientific_integrity: Correctness rests on explicit proof and reproducible integer arithmetic; no independently certified or priority-confirmed claim is made.
scientific_limitations: Result applies to simple squared cycles of order at least seven; the 2011 five-color criterion is prior work; the 48-state determinant is finitely checkable, not independent validation. A differently named earlier four-color enumeration remains an originality risk.
title: Fall-coloring spectrum and complete color-class enumerator of squared cycles
